notReplayed.createComponent#201 application/json: The response requires a Compass-linked component's read-only ari and metadata. The Compass linkage API is unmodeled, so no served setup creates that integration. Ordinary leadAccountId and assigneeType are supported by createComponent and are not a reason to exclude this example.
notReplayed.createIssue#400 application/json: This sample assumes a project field configuration making priority required. The local project has the default priority scheme and priority is optional. The field-configuration APIs that create the prerequisite are unmodeled. The createIssue description explicitly makes available/required fields depend on create metadata and project configuration.
notReplayed.getIssue#200 application/json: This example assumes issue attachments, worklogs, watches, issue links and custom fields already exist. Their mutation APIs are unmodeled in this measured on-call filing pack, so no served setup can create this complete sample. See spec getIssue response example and the literal unmodeled operations.
notReplayed.getTransitions#200 application/json: The example assumes a company-managed custom workflow with transition screen fields for a custom multiselect. The life models a simple team-managed To Do/In Progress/Done workflow with no transition screen. Workflow and custom-field configuration operations are unmodeled; spec getTransitions documents that transitions depend on the issue status.
notReplayed.searchProjects#200 application/json: The sample includes company-managed project categories, avatars and insight counters; the project category, avatar and issue insight prerequisites have no served setup APIs in this pack. Plain projects from the life remain searchable, but cannot reproduce this configured response sample.
notReplayed.getProject#200 application/json: The example assumes a configured company-managed project with categories, versions, custom roles, avatar assets and insight. The pack serves team-managed project creation and taxonomy only, and the APIs creating these sample prerequisites are unmodeled.
notReplayed.getProjectComponents#200 application/jso: This collection contains Compass-linked components with read-only ari and metadata. No served setup establishes Compass linkage. Plain Jira components and their lead/assignee fields are supported; those fields are not unavailable configuration.
notReplayed.searchAndReconsileIssuesUsingJql#200 app: The published result assumes the same attachment, worklog, watch and custom-field setup as getIssue, whose prerequisite APIs are unmodeled. The local searchable issue shape has no fabricated values for those unavailable resources.
notReplayed.searchAndReconsileIssuesUsingJqlPost#200: The published result assumes the same attachment, worklog, watch and custom-field setup as getIssue, whose prerequisite APIs are unmodeled. The POST search in the customer life covers the supported searchable shape.
notReplayed.findAssignableUsers#200 application/json: The upstream example is a single User object, while its own 200 response schema is type array with User items. A successful response cannot both be the published object and comply with the declared array. The pack returns the documented array; no successful request can replay this contradictory sample.
